guards.detail: no co-change evidence was supplied; absence of evidence is not evidence of independence
no co-change evidence was supplied; absence of evidence is not evidence of independence
the evidence envelope carries no selection object
the selection is missing completeness, receipt, or pairs; a partial artifact cannot be read as a clean one
selection version 2 is not 1; an unknown shape may mean different fields, not merely more of them
the selection carries no basisRevision; an unpinned observation cannot be recounted and asserts nothing
evidence is pinned to eb67a6f56b3bf7e71846e7324d21af44565c0b70 but the intents target 8a0b6601ca233c47d4af041102bfa1fbbd65453f; a stale observation is unknown, not clean
completeness is NOT_MINED (SHALLOW_CLONE): repository is a shallow clone; commit-graph history is truncated and co-change evidence cannot be established from it
completeness is NOT_MINED (NO_COMMITS): HEAD does not resolve to a commit in experiments/hac-330/.work/fixtures/empty
completeness is NOT_MINED (NO_REPOSITORY): ../hac330-no-repository is not a git repository, or git is unavailable
the evidence is not attributed to the repository it names: requested experiments/hac-330/.work/fixtures/baseline/probe-not-a-repository, mined experiments/hac-330/.work/fixtures/baseline
